title: No Scrubs
headline: This TLC No. 1 was written for someone else.
caption:
"Screw-up." That's how Tameka "Tiny" Cottle described the past relationship the lyrics allude to.

Follow for the story behind your next favorite song.

So 'No Scrubs' started with something real. Kandi wrote the first lines on an envelope, and she and Tiny built it into a demo for themselves. When it went to TLC, the lyrics were tweaked slightly to fit the group's image, and two versions went to radio, one with a rap verse from Lisa "Left Eye" Lopes.

Would you want to hear Kandi and Tiny's version?

🎧 The song: "No Scrubs" by TLC (@officialtlc)
